svg.aria-label: Photoshoot. Live in your browser · Windows 1.0.1. Strike a pose, pick from 17 live effects, keep the strip. Nothing from your camera ever leaves your device. Built with TypeScript, Electron and MediaPipe. The screenshot shows the red photobooth landing page.
